Class TestProgressConsole

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.test.TestProgressConsole
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, TestEventListener, TestReportListener
public final class TestProgressConsole extends Object implements TestReportListener
Shows test runs on the console as Pyronaut's pyronaut test does, so that test mode looks alike from every build tool and from Pyronaut. On a terminal, a spinner row counts the tests done and failed with the tests running under it; every test that ends becomes a permanent line, ✓ passed, ✗ failed or errored with its message and the first frames of the project beneath, – skipped; a run ends with a summary line, the report to open and, in continuous testing, the keys. Without a terminal, with TERM=dumb, or with NO_COLOR set, it prints the same as plain lines with no escape sequence: PASSED, FAILED, SKIPPED and ERROR.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher
